svg.aria-label: Unsolved rectangle with perpendicular sides nine metres and twelve metres. From opposite corners compare a direct diagonal and a walk along two adjacent edges under an eighteen metre limit. No route distances, winner, or savings shown.
svg.title: Unsolved rectangular journey
svg.desc: Only original givens: perpendicular side lengths nine and twelve metres, opposite corners, straight line or two-edge journey, eighteen metre cap. Lengths to be found by learner.
